changelog: v1.4.4 Sony A7M4 UVC Format Descriptor & Surface Transparency: 1) Matches both UVC_VS_FRAME_MJPEG (type 7) and standard MJPEG (type 1) descriptors. 2) Removed static 60 FPS telemetry string. 3) Set SurfaceView holder format to TRANSLUCENT and cleared container background to guarantee non-black viewfinder.
